title: Payment API DB Connection Timeout Spike
symptoms: Payment API endpoints return HTTP 504. Database connection pool reaches 100% saturation within 5 minutes of high traffic.
recent_changes: Database pool configuration update deployed 30 mins prior to incident.

attempts.reason_or_why: Hung connection sockets remained open in TCP CLOSE_WAIT state
Worsened database pool exhaustion as connections were held open longer

successful_action: Roll back database pool configuration update v2.4.1
root_cause: Incorrect max_connections parameter in database configuration update v2.4.1 causing connection pool deadlocks
lessons_learned: Restarting service does NOT release hanging TCP connection sockets during pool deadlocks
Increasing request timeouts exacerbates connection pool saturation
When DB timeouts follow a config update, rollback configuration before attempting application workarounds

title: Payment API Database Timeout Spike
symptoms: API requests timing out after 30 seconds. Connection pool exhaustion observed.
recent_changes: New connection-pool library version 3.1.0 deployed 20 minutes ago.
logs_snippet: FATAL: connection pool overflow (500/500 active pool connections)

attempts.reason_or_why: Connections remained blocked; pool size was mismatched with database server limit

successful_action: Configure connection pool max_size=50 in library 3.1.0 configuration
root_cause: Default pool size in connection-pool v3.1.0 library defaulted to 500 while Postgres server max_connections was set to 100
lessons_learned: Upgrade of connection-pool v3.1.0 resets default max pool limit to 500
Always align application connection pool limits with DB server limits prior to deployment

title: [PRODUCTION AUDIT] Ledger timeout baseline
symptoms: Ledger writes time out while the queue backs up and database connections saturate.
recent_changes: Routine traffic increase; no deployment or configuration change reported.
logs_snippet: write latency p99 above 8s; active DB connections at limit
successful_action: Restore ledger writer concurrency to 24 workers
root_cause: Worker concurrency exceeded the database connection budget, exhausting available connections.
lessons_learned: Keep ledger writer concurrency within the database connection budget.
Restarting workers does not resolve a concurrency limit mismatch.
